knowledge:
- key_parameters: tolerance_val=Chromosomal alteration rate threshold in computeNormalChromosomes (minimum percentage of alterations tolerated per arm; suggested 0.5 for <200 samples, and 0.20-0.25 for ~1000 samples) ;; clust_method=Clustering method used in DRrefit and PlotChrCluster ("ward.D", "ward.D2", "single", "complete", "average", "mcquitty", "median", "centroid", or "kmeans"; default is "ward.D2") ;; maxCN=Maximum copy number threshold in DRrefit (default is 6) ;; compression_factor=Factor used to calculate copy number from logR segment mean (0.55 for SNP array data, 1.0 for WGS/WES data) ;; plot_viewer=Logical indicating whether to display the DRrefit_plot in the R viewer ;; plot_save=Logical indicating whether to save the DRrefit_plot to a file ;; plot_format=Format of the saved plot (e.g., "pdf") ;; plot_path=Directory path where the plot will be saved
- alternatives: None mentioned.
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing tumor copy number profiles (especially those with complex karyotypes) where the diploid region may be misidentified or shifted, requiring recalibration and refitting.
- pitfalls: Failing to apply the correct compression factor (0.55 for SNP array vs 1.0 for WGS/WES) when calculating copy number from Segment_Mean ;; Missing chromosome arm information in the input data (must run Popeye first to assign arms) ;; NbClust clustering failure (indicated by "FAIL" in the clustering report column), which means the sample will not present clusters and the input chromosome list will be kept as reference.

workflows.name: copy_number_refitting
workflows.intent: Prepare copy number segment data, identify normal chromosomes, refit the diploid region, and visualize the corrected profiles and clusters.
input: data.txt (A tab-separated or data frame object containing copy number segments with columns: ID, chr, start, end, Num_Probes, Segment_Mean, Sample)
workflows.stages: 1. Assign chromosome arms to segments using Popeye ;; 2. Calculate copy number values using a platform-specific compression factor ;; 3. Identify normal (unaltered) chromosomes using computeNormalChromosomes ;; 4. Refit and recalibrate copy number profiles using DRrefit ;; 5. Plot the original vs corrected copy number profiles using DRrefit_plot ;; 6. Visualize chromosome clustering using PlotChrCluster
workflows.code:
segments <- Popeye(data)
compression_factor <- 0.55
segments$CN <- 2^(segments$Segment_Mean/compression_factor + 1)
chr_list <- computeNormalChromosomes(segments = TCGA_BRCA_CN_segments, 
				     tolerance_val = 0.25)
results <- DRrefit (segments_chort = TCGA_BRCA_CN_segments, chrlist = chr_list)
corrected_segments <- results$corrected_segments
report <- results$report
DRrefit_plot(corrected_segments = corrected_segments,
             DRrefit_report = report,
             plot_viewer = TRUE,
             plot_save = FALSE )
Cluster <- PlotChrCluster(segs = TCGA_BRCA_CN_segments,
                       clust_method = "ward.D2",
                       plot_output= TRUE)
